name: text-field
description: Labeled text field that owns the mistake and the recovery: shakes once on error with a reject haptic, goes quiet on the first keystroke, clears with one tap, and counts against a limit without blocking.
avoidWhen: Do not use for passwords or one-time codes; use password-field or otp-input. Do not set isError on every keystroke; set it on submit or blur.

ux.behaviour: Supporting text is a hint line under the field; the same line carries the error, so nothing moves when the error arrives
ux.why: A form that jumps when you get something wrong feels like it is punishing you

ux.behaviour: A clear button appears whenever the field has text; tapping it empties the field and keeps focus there
ux.why: Retyping an email should not start with holding backspace

ux.behaviour: With maxLength, a counter reads n / max and turns the field to error past the limit without refusing input
ux.why: You can see how far over you are and fix it, instead of typing into a wall

ux.behaviour: When isError turns on, the field shakes once and fires the reject haptic; the message shows on the field in the error colour
ux.why: The refusal is felt before it is read
ux.reducedMotion: No shake; haptic and error text only

ux.behaviour: The first keystroke after an error drops the error colour; the message stays as a quiet hint. On blur, if the caller still flags the value, the error returns
ux.why: You are already fixing it; the field stops shouting but does not forget

ux.behaviour: Whether the current error was already felt survives rotation, so the refusal is not repeated for the same mistake
ux.why: Turning the phone is not a second mistake

aiHints: Set isError on submit or blur, not per keystroke; the field hides the error while the person edits and shows it again on blur if you still flag it
Pass supportingText as a hint even when there is no error; the error replaces it on the same line so the form does not jump
When you pass trailingIcon you replace the clear button; do that only when your icon is the more useful action (password-field does)
maxLength does not block input; validate length on submit like any other rule
Attach error text to the field, not only a color change
